text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d a p-e-r-s-o-n-a a n-d d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d i-t a-s a p-h-i-s-h-i-n-g m-o-d-e l, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e p-r-o-f-i-l-e d-a-t-a b-e-h-i-n-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-n-t m-o-l-l-a-n-d e-x-t-r-a-c-t i-o-n m-e-s-s-a-g-e s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g p-h-i-s-h-y c-a-l-l r-e-c-o-r-d s b-e-h-i-n-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a l s-a-f-e-t-y c-h-e-c-k s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e s t-h-r-o-u-g-h m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g o-n-c-h-a-i-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t l-e-a-d s b-e-h-i-n-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g k-n-o-w-n m-u-l-e f-i-l-t-e-r s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-s-o-l-a-t-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m s f-r-o-m p-e-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-e-a-r-b-a-s-e d c-o-n-t-r-o l n-o-t-e s b-e-h-i-n-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g a-w-a-r-e-n-e-s-s p-r-o-m-p-t s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-l-t-e-r-e-d c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n m-e-t-h-o-d s t-o o-b-f-u-s-c-a-t-e t-h-e s-c-h-e-m-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g e-n-c-r-y-p-t-e d c-h-a-n-n-e l l-o-g s b-e-h-i-n-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g o-a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i l c-o-n-s-e-r-v-a-t-i-o-n.
